title: Night-time out-of-correspondence alarms correlated across two machines
asset: Point machine PM-128, junction K7 (with neighbour PM-129)
description: PM-128 raises intermittent out-of-correspondence alarms between 02:00 and 04:00 for the third night in a row. The mechanism appears healthy during the day.

evidence.summary: OOC-09: out-of-correspondence on PM-128, 7 occurrences over 3 nights, all between 02:00 and 04:10, each self-clearing within 30 s
PM-128 supply voltage dips to 96 V (nominal 110 V) exactly during each OOC-09 occurrence
PM-128 and PM-129 share feeder F-7; PM-129 logged undervoltage events with identical timestamps all 3 nights
New LED yard lighting bank was connected to feeder F-7 last month (WO-7590); lighting runs on night timer 01:55-04:15

Vendor manual 7.4.1: OOC alarms correlated with undervoltage on multiple machines indicate a power supply/feeder problem, not a point-machine defect; investigate the feeder before touching the machines
evidence.source: PM-100 series maintenance manual rev D

evidence.summary: SR-18: heavy interventions (machine swap, mechanism overhaul) require a confirmed diagnosis; no speculative component replacement in service
No maintenance performed on PM-128 or PM-129 in the last 4 months
Daytime behaviour of PM-128: throw time 4.1 s, current 4.5 A, detection stable - all nominal

allowed_actions.label: Analyze feeder F-7 voltage log and correlate with connected loads
Physical inspection of PM-128 mechanism and detection
Stop and hand over to the responsible team

forbidden_actions.label: Replace PM-128 with a spare machine

inspect_feeder_voltage_log.summary: F-7 voltage dips align exactly with LED lighting bank switching cycles; both PMs affected simultaneously; lighting inrush overloads the feeder

new_evidence.summary: F-7 dips correlate 1:1 with LED lighting bank timer cycles (01:55-04:15); PM-128 and PM-129 dip simultaneously; feeder overloaded by lighting inrush

inspect_pm128_mechanism.summary: Mechanism, lock and drive all within tolerance; no defect found

new_evidence.summary: PM-128 mechanism/lock/drive within tolerance, no defect

inspect_detection_contacts.summary: Detection contacts within wear limits, clean

new_evidence.summary: PM-128 detection contacts clean and within wear limits

labels.root_cause: Feeder F-7 undervoltage caused by newly connected LED yard lighting bank overloading the feeder at night; point machines healthy
